utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-08-91-T, the Prosecutor versus Mico Stanisic and Stojan Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. Good morning to everyone. May we have the appearances, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Joanna Korner, assisted by Crispian Smith for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. CVIJETIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. On behalf of Mr. Stanisic's team, Slobodan Cvijetic, Tatjana Savic, and Deirdre Montgomery.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For Zupljanin Defence this morning, Igor Pantelic, Dragan Krgovic, Jason Antley, and Miroslav Cuskic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you. And could we revert to closed session and have the usher escort the witness back to the stand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you. The counsel will of course appreciate that the time means that today's conference, 65 ter conference, has had to be postponed, and we're refixing it for 11.00 tomorrow morning. It is likely to be in this courtroom, which would have been reserved for the continuation of the trial in any event. If there is a change, counsel will be notified in the usual manner. So we would reconvene in this housekeeping session tomorrow, but the trial proper is adjourned to Monday afternoon in this courtroom at 2.15. So we rise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 23rd day of April, 2010, at 11.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.43 p.m.,
